description: Actionable — Personal and Actionable — Work show the available tasks in the folder designated for each, and every folder and project inside it, as individual actions grouped by tag in sidebar order, oldest first within a group, then the tasks with no tag. A task with several tags appears under each. Selecting a tag shows its branch; the sidebar keeps only the tags with available tasks, their ancestors, the selected tag and, when there are tasks with no tag, an “untagged” entry. “Personal” holds a single-action list and, in a nested “Home” folder, a project and a paused project; “Work” holds one project; one project is in neither. See the built-in perspectives table and “Hierarchical tag browsing” in the spec.

examples.name: Only available tasks in the designated folder show, grouped by tag, oldest first, with untagged tasks last
Selecting a tag shows the groups of its branch, and the sidebar keeps only tags with available tasks and their ancestors
A selected tag stays in the sidebar when it has no available tasks, with nothing to show
A deferred task joins its group when its defer date arrives
The folders are held by identity: designating the nested Home folder shows only what is inside it, and with no folder designated nothing shows
